experiments.study_type: Viral gene delivery for DBI knockdown and chronic pain models (SNI and CFA)
experiments.procedure_text: AAV-mediated DBI knockdown or overexpression in L4 DRG followed by behavioral pain sensitivity testing in SNI and CFA pain models.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: AAV5-gfaABC1D-DBI-EGFP virions... Mechanical and heat sensitivity was monitored after the induction of the spared nerve injury model... Mechanical and heat sensitivity was monitored after the induction of the Complete Freund's Adjuvant inflammatory pain model
experiments.test_system_evidence: behavioural tests were performed 48 h after the injection
experiments.route_evidence: L4 DRG of C57BL/6 male mice as previously described

endpoints.label: mechanical sensitivity
endpoints.evidence: Mechanical (von Frey; C) and heat (Hargreaves; D) sensitivity was monitored

endpoints.label: heat sensitivity
endpoints.evidence: Mechanical (von Frey; C) and heat (Hargreaves; D) sensitivity was monitored

substances.name: Complete Freund's adjuvant
substances.evidence: mice were injected with 20 μl of complete Freund's adjuvant

experiments.exposure_evidence: virion solution (1.1 -1.2x10 12 vg/ml; 2 μl) was injected slowly
experiments.guideline_ref_evidence: Reporting of In vivo Experiments (ARRIVE) guidelines
experiments.notes: Experimental procedures performed at multiple institutions under different ethical approvals.
